promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-12 (ercot-192) UNDER THE PRE-REGISTERED DIRECTION-BLIND RULE of the precommit §7 (docs/PRECOMMIT-ercot192-coal-limbs-2023-reapplication-2026-08-12.md; owner signature B1, DECISION-CARD-ercot188 card B, 2026-08-11: 're-adjudicate under a fresh precommit before any arm'). ONE DELTA on the run191 keeper recipe: coal_peak_offer_yearly_level=true, the year-keyed 2023 coal `_peak` offer LEVEL 71.3378 $/MWh. ZERO FITTED SCALARS. *** THE OBJECT IS A MIS-IDENTIFICATION (rules 1/23), NOT A PRICE RESIDUAL: ERCOT-140 identified 35.1989 on the 2024/25 SCED subsets and declared its 2023 application an extrapolation ('no 2023 SCED disclosure exists'); the ercot-157 delivery-2023 corpus dissolved that premise, and the constant's OWN instrument reads p90 = 75.00 $/MWh on the 2023 rows — level_2023 71.3378, +36.1389 = 14.42x the +/-$2.5062 identification band, i.e. the armed constant was roughly HALF the measured 2023 top (the corpus's two most common submitted TOP steps in delivery-2023 are $78.00 on 21,677 intervals and $75.01 on 17,869; $34.82 is a distant tenth). *** THE COVERAGE OBJECTION IS CLOSED BY BOUND, NOT BY REPAIR. ercot-169 could not license the read (curve_share 0.9702 vs the 0.9876 floor) and ercot-171 proved the licensed-sub-population route cannot reach a p90 of the curve TOP (G-NEUT +19.17 = 7.6x band), closing with 'an instrument that does not select on the tail would need its own charter'. B1 chartered it and it needs no repair at all: the no-curve rows carry ZERO weight in a weighted quantile, so that weight is given the most extreme admissible price in each direction and the SAME statistic recomputed, bracketing the true quantile under ANY imputation whatsoever. The LOWER edge is 71.3378 in ALL THREE windows (matched-CST [71.3378, 81.3678], full-day [71.3378, 71.3578], raw-CPT [71.3378, 96.3378]), so 2023's level is at least 14.42 band-widths above the armed constant no matter what the missing rows would have said — card B's 'a 1.7 pp coverage shortfall cannot produce a 2x level shift' is now MEASURED rather than asserted. Nothing dropped, nothing imputed, no licensing quantity swapped, the 0.9876 floor NOT lowered. TWO ALTERNATIVE REPAIRS WERE REFUSED IN THE PUSHED PRECOMMIT BEFORE ANY LEVEL WAS READ, on the Phase-0a structure measurement: own-conduct imputation (98.8 % of the missing headroom is ERCOT-123 bucket (b) price-taking at 98 % loading, so imputing a curve would invent an offer that was never submitted — rule 13) and re-expressing the licence on the exposure-matched a_offered (measured 0.94775 on 2023, WORSE than curve_share; a licensing quantity may never be chosen after seeing which one passes). *** AMENDMENT 1, RECORDED NOT QUIETLY APPLIED: the measurement caught a real defect in the precommit's own G-NEUT. The two limbs' identifications pool the four subsets with DIFFERENT arithmetics (ERCOT-140 anchors per subset and pools the anchored levels; ERCOT-137 pools the RAW bot_p50 with no anchoring, and its registered anchor 1.7387 is the three-year mean while the pool sits at the 2024/25 mean fuel ~1.7040), so applying one to both measured an anchoring inconsistency in the committed ERCOT-137 derivation rather than anything about the bound. The gate was split into the two halves its own sentence asks for; neither is weakened and the half carrying the 2023 verdict is the strict one. Measured: footing -0.0024 (limb A) / +2.6e-5 (limb C); LOWER-edge displacement 0.065x / 0.000x band. REPORTED NOT BURIED: the OPPOSITE edge displaces 2.635x band on those same licensed subsets, because a p90 of a steep curve top admits a large upward excursion from even 0.3-0.7 % missing weight. *** LIMB A (coal_offer_net_revenue_margin) IS NOT-IDENTIFIABLE under this instrument (G-WINDOW: STRADDLES on the matched window, REFUTED full-day). The bound does NOT contradict ercot-171's CONFIRMED — it simply cannot sharpen it — and NO arm and NO change follow. *** ALL PRE-REGISTERED KILL GATES PASS: G-BIT (2024 AND 2025 BYTE-IDENTICAL A->B — all 12 hourly-sidecar sha256s plus the per-year price/demand aggregates), G-COAL148 carried live (max rise 0.0 TWh vs the 0.5 bar; 2023 -0.0033), G-SHED (4/1/0 -> 4/1/0, slack MWh identical, no new shed year), G-DOF (zero fitted scalars; n_residual 6 UNCHANGED). G-OWNER does not escalate: C3a-2024 -0.8 % PASS, C3b-2024 0.135, C3a-2025 -7.5 %, all bit-identical to control. *** NOT C3a-2023 SPEND (card Q ruling Q-B, final at ercot-191). The residual moves are REPORTED AT FULL MAGNITUDE, were NEVER targeted, are not a gate and are NOT the promotion basis: C3a-2023 -33.7 -> -33.2 % ($42.63 -> $42.97 vs actual $64.32), C3b-2023 0.610 -> 0.604, C3c tails 58/181, 22/53, 1/31 UNCHANGED. NO C3a-2023 improvement is claimed. DETERMINATION NOT-YET, fail set {C3a-2023, C3b-2023} — UNCHANGED; C3c stays the single ledgered CAVEAT x3 (ACCEPTED MODEL-CLASS LIMITATION), carry text updated on both bundles. *** LOYO structurally N/A: one measured constant applied to ONE year, with 2024 and 2025 bit-identical by G-BIT — which IS the held-out evidence, since the change cannot buy in-sample gain anywhere but 2023. *** CARD B's STANDING DOF ITEM DISCHARGED: the three armed margin constants (ERCOT-137/139/140) now carry dedicated DOF-ledger entries on BOTH arms, carrying limb B's ercot-169 verification (boundary-coverage caveat), limb A's ercot-171 verification, and the newly measured ERCOT-137 anchoring inconsistency (+0.38 = 0.41x band — inside the band, arming unchanged, filed as an open convention issue). *** INHERITED NAMED PERMANENT LIMITATION (ercot-188/E2, unexpired): ercot_econ_curve_top_refine writes heat rates into the P0 objective, so the offer-surface family's P0 bit-identity proof remains FORFEITED on this keeper. ERCOT holds no complete and no final marker, so no calibration-complete.json re-key applies (rule 22 / D-5(b)). Promotion is DIRECTION-BLIND because the prior keeper rests on an aggregation the record calls wrong (rules 1/14): the residual moves are reported at full magnitude and were NOT the basis — C3a-2023 -32.8% -> -33.7% ($43.23 -> $42.63 vs actual $64.32), C3b-2023 0.608 -> 0.610, C3a-2024 +1.2% -> -0.8% PASS, C3a-2025 -8.0% -> -7.5% PASS, C3b-2024 0.158 -> 0.135, C3c tails 58/181 unchanged, 23 -> 22/53, 3 -> 1/31, G-SHED 4/2/0 -> 4/1/0 (no new shed year). The [7c] operating-shape report gate shows 15 cf_emd/r regressions vs the run188 baseline (CC_CHP/CC_REGULAR/COAL) — reported UN-TARGETED: correct availability that worsens a shape metric is rule-14 territory (the estimate was compensating) and the root cause stays open. THE SAME SESSION EXECUTED THE SIGNED ercot-190 CARD-Q CHECKPOINT on the repaired deriver: the ercot-170 coverage licence FAILED (L1 0.3857 vs 0.90; L2 0.0000 PASS; FILED-UNLICENSED) — (Q-B) AUTOMATIC AND FINAL: no further ERCOT C3a-2023 spend, ERCOT stands at NOT-YET on C3a-2023 as a model-class limit (item 11 CLOSED; results/calibration/ercot191_cc_headroom_licence_retest.json). INHERITED NAMED PERMANENT LIMITATION (ercot-188/E2, carried unexpired): ercot_econ_curve_top_refine writes heat rates into the P0 objective, so the offer-surface family's P0 bit-identity proof remains FORFEITED on this keeper. *** PRIOR NOTE (run188, preserved verbatim): PROMOTED 2026-08-11 (ercot-188) BY EXPLICIT OWNER DECISION — the signable open-ruling board, card E, option E2 ('promote on the standing structural standard'), taken AGAINST this session's own recommendation of E1 (do not promote) and against the mechanical verdict. *** THE PRE-REGISTERED MECHANICAL VERDICT IS REJECTED-AS-ARMED AND IS NOT REWRITTEN: G-C3c FAILS (2023 model tail 61 -> 58 against an actual 181, i.e. 3 h FURTHER from actual). The promotion is the owner's standing structural standard applied ON TOP of that verdict, not a re-scoring of it. *** WHAT IT IS: the ercot185 recipe plus ONE mechanism delta, ercot_econ_curve_top_refine=true — SCHEME R1 of the (c2) cliff-resolving offer-curve refinement, itself built under the OWNER'S option (B) BUILD ANYWAY on the MEMO-ercot184 §8 card over that memo's own recommendation to CLOSE. offer_curves._econ_curve_steps cut each plant's econ ramp into offer_curve_smoothing_n = 6 EQUAL-WIDTH MW blocks, so the finest within-plant position the model could express was 1/6 of the ramp — a supply-curve top that CANNOT express a cliff, while reality's marginal price forms inside the top 0.24 % of the marginal resource's own submitted curve (q_act p50 0.9976, ercot-180). Armed, the ramp's TOP block is re-sliced n ways with the body's n-1 blocks left expression-for-expression identical (2n-1 = 11 slices, top sliver 2.778 % of the ramp). ZERO NEW SCALARS (rule 23): the split point is 1 - 1/n, the boundary the ramp is ALREADY sliced at, and the sub-slice count is the same n — both the registered offer_curve_smoothing_n — so the shape FOLLOWS n and the DOF ledger is the prior keeper's, verbatim. *** WHAT IT BUYS, AND IT IS REPRESENTATIONAL ONLY: econ rows in the measured top decile go 33 -> 382, quoting up to 145x delivered gas, with capacity conserved to 1.5e-11 MW. THE MODEL CAN NOW EXPRESS A CLIFF; IT STILL DOES NOT CLEAR ON ONE — item 23's conclusion reproduced from the opposite direction by a real LP. *** MEASURED OUTCOME, AT FULL MAGNITUDE AND IN THE WRONG DIRECTION: C3a-2023 -32.5 % -> -32.8 % ($43.44 -> $43.23 against an actual $64.32), i.e. -$0.21/MWh; C3b-2023 0.602 -> 0.608. Per-year C3a deltas -0.21 / -0.08 / -0.03 $/MWh — uniformly slightly negative, so no in-sample gain was bought with held-out degradation. ercot-184's invariant-quantity mirror had put R1's ceiling at +$1.99/MWh; the real LP delivered a SIGN FLIP, inside the precommit's pre-registered reconciliation band [-$1.00, +$4.00] so no STOP fired. C3b-2024 improves marginally 0.160 -> 0.158. DETERMINATION NOT-YET, fail set {C3a-2023, C3b-2023} — UNCHANGED. *** GATES: PASS G-SHED (4/2/0 -> 4/2/0; the ercot-48/49 manufactured-shortage falsifier has killed this object twice and missed cleanly here at SOLVE grain, corroborating MEMO §4.6's build-free zero-shed-exposure result), G-OWNER (C3a-2024 keeps PASS +1.4 -> +1.2 %; C3b-2024 under 0.20; C3a-2025 -8.0 % vs the -9.1 % bound), G-SPUR (10->9, 11->11, 1->1), G-COAL148 (max rise -0.0 TWh vs the 0.5 bar), G-DOF (zero new scalars), G-COST (LP columns x1.295, UNDER the memo's x1.39 estimate; peak RSS 12.71 vs the control's 10.20 GB, inside the box, no year dropped). FAIL G-C3c, stated above. LOYO: parameter-free rule, so leave-one-year-out is N/A and per-year deltas stand in its place (ercot-173 precedent). *** SEAM PROOF ALL_ASSERTIONS_PASS (ercot188_topfine_seamproof.json): SP-1 gate-off byte-identical to pre-edit HEAD x3 years; SP-2 — the charter's mandatory cross-ISO assertion — all five non-ERCOT ISOs BYTE-IDENTICAL with the gate ARMED, each reconstructed from its own committed bundle and each carrying real econc rows (CAISO 128 / PJM 227 / NYISO 45 / NEISO 38 / MISO 147 plant-groups, so not vacuous); SP-3 fleet MW deviation 1.5e-11; SP-3b CHP steam floor redistributed, never created or destroyed; SP-4 body byte-identical in cap AND heat rate; SP-5 slice counts exactly {6, 11}; SP-6 committed band unrefined; SP-7 pinned default cache key 603c2498bf71d21d UNMOVED, armed key 613cd5243fd84f20 distinct. AMENDMENT 1 (pre-solve): the pre-registered falsifier CAUGHT A REAL DEFECT — the first build hit the assembly's pre-existing 0.5 MW tranche floor and DELETED 40.27 MW/yr from 36 of 144 plant-groups; the guard applies R1 only where every sub-slice clears that floor (108/144 groups = 99.331 % of econ MW), adds no parameter and substitutes no scheme. *** THE NAMED PERMANENT LIMITATION THIS KEEPER CARRIES, AND IT DOES NOT EXPIRE: this is the FIRST offer-side ERCOT mechanism since ERCOT-86 that does NOT ride the P1-only mc_bid_adjust seam. The slicer writes heat rates into the BASE fleet, i.e. into the P0 objective, so it BREACHES that seam and PERMANENTLY FORFEITS the offer-surface family's P0 bit-identity proof. Every control-vs-arm difference on this keeper is confounded with commitment-side motion, so a mechanism can be isolated here only by ARGUMENT, never by proof — the ercot-181 seam proof's byte-identity assertions have no analogue. Measured: 73 of 132 committed rows (12,474 MW) carry a different P0 commitment pattern, and the gas commitment bridge's floored unit-hours move in all three years (12,375->12,309 / 6,164->6,160 / 13,326->13,287). WHAT THE P0 DECOMPOSITION DOES NOT SUPPORT, AND IS NOT CLAIMED: P0 energy is conserved to 2.8e-05 TWh on 303 TWh and the start-amortization arithmetic is two orders of magnitude too small to carry the annual price move; NOTHING apportions the residual between the ladder and commitment channels, because no counterfactual separates them — they are the same code change. That inability IS the forfeited proof, measured rather than predicted. *** COST ACCEPTED BY THE OWNER: x1.295 LP columns on a keeper whose added 540 rows are measured never to be cleared on.
